report_name: iRhythm Notifies Over 360,000 Patients of Data Breach from June

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Extortion Group
threat_actors.description: An unnamed threat actor who gained unauthorized access to iRhythm's third-party hosted business applications, exfiltrated patient data, and subsequently issued a ransom demand.

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: The incident was a supply chain attack targeting a third-party service provider hosting iRhythm's business applications, leading to unauthorized access to patient data.

attack_patterns.name: External Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: The initial access vector likely involved exploiting a vulnerability or using compromised credentials to access the third-party hosted business applications from the internet.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attacker may have used compromised valid accounts to gain legitimate access to the third-party hosted environment.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: Attackers navigated the cloud-hosted environment to locate and access sensitive patient data stored in business applications.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
attack_patterns.description: The attackers downloaded patient data from the third-party environment to an attacker-controlled location between June 3 and June 8, 2026.

attack_patterns.name: Financial Theft
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor contacted iRhythm on June 9 with a ransom demand for the stolen data, confirming the motive was financial gain through extortion.

identities.name: iRhythm Technologies
identities.description: A manufacturer of heart monitoring medical devices that suffered a data breach via a third-party vendor, affecting over 360,000 patients' PII and PHI.

infrastructure.name: Compromised Third-Party Application Hosting Environment
infrastructure.description: A third-party vendor's environment hosting business applications for iRhythm, which was compromised by attackers to access and exfiltrate patient data.

indicators.name: Anomalous Cloud Application Login Patterns
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Cloud Application Login Patterns
id: 7c5a8d4e-1b2f-4c3d-a9e8-f7b6a5c4d3e2
status: experimental
description: 'Detects anomalous access patterns, such as logins from unusual geographic locations or multiple failed login attempts followed by a success, which could indicate a compromised account.'
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/irhythm-data-breach-impacts-over-360000-people/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-12
tags:
  - attack.t1133
  - attack.t1078
level: medium
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: signinlogs
detection:
  selection:
    ResultType: 0
    # Add a list of high-risk or unusual locations
    Location|contains:
      - 'RU'
      - 'CN'
      - 'IR'
      - 'KP'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate user activity from these locations.
indicators.description: Based on hunting hint to look for anomalous access patterns, such as logins from unusual geographic locations.

indicators.name: Large Volume Data Export from Cloud Application
indicators.pattern:
title: Large Volume Data Export from Cloud Application
id: 9e8f7b6a-5c4d-4e3f-b2a1-c0d9e8f7b6a5
status: experimental
description: 'Detects large or unusual data export events from business applications, which could indicate data exfiltration.'
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/irhythm-data-breach-impacts-over-360000-people/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-12
tags:
  - attack.t1530
  - attack.t1567
level: medium
logsource:
  category: application
  product: generic
detection:
  selection:
    keywords:
      - 'Data Export'
      - 'Bulk Download'
      - 'Report Generated'
  # This rule is conceptual and would need to be tuned with volume thresholds in a real SIEM.
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate bulk data operations by administrators or automated systems.
indicators.description: Based on hunting hint to alert on large or unusual data export events from business applications.

indicators.name: Anomalous High-Volume Record Access
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous High-Volume Record Access
id: 1b2f3c4d-5e6f-4a9b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: 'Detects a user session that accesses an abnormally large number of records or performs unusual actions compared to its baseline, suggesting potential data collection.'
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/irhythm-data-breach-impacts-over-360000-people/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-12
tags:
  - attack.t1530
level: medium
logsource:
  category: ueba
detection:
  selection:
    # This is a conceptual UEBA rule. The fields and logic are placeholders.
    event_type: 'record_access'
    user_session_id: '*'
  aggregation:
    # Count record accesses per user session over a time window
    count(event_type) by user_session_id > 1000 # Threshold to be defined by baseline
  timeframe: 1h
  condition: selection and aggregation
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative tasks or reporting jobs.
indicators.description: Based on hunting hint for a user session accessing an abnormally large number of records.
